description_en: Queries the list of schedule time periods for sound codes
description_zh: 调用该接口查询声码排程时间段列表
name: QuerySchedulePeriodList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must provide it. Otherwise, the call will fail.
If no ID value exists, you do not need to provide one.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the schedule
parameters.name: schedule_code

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回的语料条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the results to return. Valid values: 1 to 10,000. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页。取值范围1~10,000，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Description.description_en: The description of the time period

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the time period, in HH:mm format
EndTime.description_zh: 时间段结束时间，格式为 HH:mm

PeriodCode.description_en: The unique identifier of the time period

SoundCodeContent.description_en: The parsed content of the sound code for the time period

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the time period, in HH:mm format
StartTime.description_zh: 时间段开始时间，格式为 HH:mm

PageSize.description_en: The number of time periods returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页返回的时间段条数

Total.description_en: The total number of time periods returned by the query
Total.description_zh: 查询返回的时间段总条数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
